title: Use permissive index signatures on entity data interfaces to prevent TS2571 unknown errors

violation.problem: Typing the index signature as `[key: string]: unknown;` causes existing code accessing unmodeled entity properties (e.g. screen.data.something) to fail with TS2571: Object is of type 'unknown'.
violation.expectedSolution: Type index signatures on entity data interfaces with `any` (`[key: string]: any;`), preserving TypeScript autocomplete on modeled fields while allowing existing code to access properties without compile errors.
